Hi Kimberly,

We're almost ready to countersign the order form but need to confirm a few insurance details before legal can complete their checklist:

- Can Redwood provide a certificate of insurance and the additional-insured endorsement?
- Required naming: "Acme Corp, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates" — please confirm if that exact wording works.
- Minimum limits requested: Commercial General Liability 1M/2M, Auto 1M, Professional/Tech E&O 1M, Cyber/Privacy 5M.
- Any issues with waiver of subrogation? Acme requires waiver in favor of Acme Corp.
- Target: we need COI & endorsement on file before our procurement team releases PO/invoice hold. What is your expected delivery timeline once Order Form is fully executed?

I've attached Acme's COI request form for reference (see attachment). If you could confirm by EOD Wednesday that would be great — legal is trying to close the loop this week.

Thanks,

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and the form. Looping in Aditya (sales) and Hannah from Legal so we can coordinate next steps and any redline questions.

Short answers up front:
- Redwood can provide a Certificate of Insurance with an additional-insured endorsement on commercial general liability.
- We typically accept naming that follows your suggested phrasing, but Legal will confirm whether we need a slight variation for contractual entity matching. Please confirm the exact full legal entity name for the Order Form (including punctuation).
- Limits: we can meet the CGL/Auto/E&O numbers you listed; Cyber/Privacy at 5M may require review with our carrier — we'll confirm within 48 hours.
- Waiver of subrogation: we can typically do this on CGL where permitted by policy; we'll verify with our broker.

Timeline: Once we have a fully executed Order Form (DocuSign link below) and the correct legal entity to name, Risk Operations (via our broker) can issue a COI and endorsement within ~7–10 business days in normal conditions. If you need faster turnaround we can escalate but will likely need evidence of executed document and confirmation from your broker of the requested naming.

I've attached our current MSA redlines so your legal team can see any outstanding items; happy to set a short call if needed.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-ACME-2026-1129

Hi all — IronHill Insurance here (Redwood's broker). Happy to support. A few clarifying notes:

- We can issue a COI and endorsement naming the additional insured as requested once we have proof of coverage binder and effective policy period.
- To name Acme as an additional insured we need the exact legal entity (e.g., "Acme Corp, Inc.") and any required jurisdictional qualifiers.
- E&O/Tech/Professional liability and Cyber coverage are under separate programs; Cyber at 5M is possible but depends on recent underwriting information — if Redwood provides prior loss runs we can expedite.
- Typical turnaround: 5–10 business days after receipt of executed Order Form + signed coverage authorization from Redwood.

I attached an endorsement example and your ACME form filled with broker notes. If procurement can confirm the legal entity and whether they require endorsement on primary policy vs. Acord wording, we can get an ETA.
